name: Biome
description: Formatter and linter for web languages.
summary: Any AI assistance must be disclosed in the PR along with its extent. Don't use AI to write PR descriptions or other communication with the project.

evidence.quote: If you are using any kind of AI assistance to contribute to Biome, it must be disclosed in the pull request.
If you relied on AI assistance to make a pull request, you must disclose it in the pull request, together with the extent of the usage.
Please do not use AI to write pull request descriptions or contributor communication for this project.
